title: spec(automation): NotifyConfigSchema sourceObject / sourceId / actionUrl describe text omits the trigger-record default link that PR #30252 ships
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1mkgEris4MHHLjtnk

Filing gate ①: a shipped text that is now incomplete, at a named location. This is item 3 of #30254, which that card's file surface left out because it is spec-lane work; the contract review of PR #30682 (record 6671186834) verified it is still stale. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it (expected `domain:spec`). Suggested-grade: p3 · describe text only, the runtime is already right.

## Observed (`origin/main` `b77c160a`)

`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`:

- L750 `sourceObject` `.describe()`: "Only takes effect together with sourceId — a half-specified click-through target is dropped at execute time".
- L756 `sourceId` `.describe()`: the same sentence.
- L765-766 `actionUrl` `.describe()`: "Overrides the link synthesized from sourceObject/sourceId."

None of them says what PR #30252 (#30121) made the runtime do: a `notify` that writes none of `sourceObject`, `sourceId` and `actionUrl` links to the run's trigger record when the run has one (a record change other than a delete, a time-relative sweep's row, an action started on a record). The node's own config-schema descriptions already say it (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts:885`, `:889`, `:902`). These describes feed `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx` on regenerate.

## Wanted

The three `.describe()` texts (and their JSDoc) state the default and its exceptions, reusing `notify-node.ts`'s wording: an explicit pair or `actionUrl` wins, a half pair is dropped, a run with no trigger record links nowhere. Regenerate the reference page. No schema shape changes (`Clause-②: no`).

Reader: the `domain:spec` lane. Links: #30254, #30121, PR #30252, PR #30682.

Dedupe: `io-node-config sourceId describe` → 10 hits and `notify "trigger record" describe` → 63 hits; nearest #7085 / #7112 (closed, older "Requires …" wording), none about the trigger-record default. **New.**
